# Justice Equity Services Index (JESI) Component Results {.tabset .tabset-fade}

## Health & Wellness

```{r}

# risk: [ "rgb(237,248,233)", "rgb(186,228,179)", "rgb(116,196,118)", "rgb(49,163,84)", "rgb(0,109,44)" ],​



#green
pal_impact <- colorBin(palette = c("#006416","#168219", "#66AB5D", "#bae4b3","#edf8e9" ), domain = jesi$c1_health_well_pctl, bins = 5, reverse = TRUE, pretty = FALSE)


# #create popup
popup <- paste("<div class='hasjesi'><div class='health-leaflet-data' data-zip='", jesi$zipcode,
               "' data-neighborhood='",jesi$lat_neighborhood,
               "' data-jesi-pctl='",jesi$jesi_pctl,
               "' data-jesi-category='",jesi$jesi_category,
               "' data-jesi-rank='",jesi$jesi_rank,
               "' data-population='",prettyNum(jesi$population_count, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none"),
               "' data-sd-number='",jesi$sd_number,
               "' data-sd-name='",jesi$sd_name,
               "' data-spa-number='",jesi$spa_number,
               "' data-spa-name='",jesi$spa_name,
               "' data-health-category='",jesi$c1_health_well_category,
               "' data-house-category='",jesi$c2_housing_emp_category,
               "' data-preven-category='",jesi$c3_preven_inter_category,
               "' data-fam-category='",jesi$c4_fam_comm_category,
               "' data-health-pctl='",jesi$c1_health_well_pctl,
               "' data-house-pctl='",jesi$c2_housing_emp_pctl,
               "' data-preven-pctl='",jesi$c3_preven_inter_pctl,
               "' data-fam-pctl='",jesi$c4_fam_comm_pctl,
               "' data-total-health-services='",jesi$c1_health_well_raw_count,
               "' data-physical-health-services='",jesi$phys_health_raw_count,
               "' data-behavioral-health-services='",jesi$behav_health_raw_count,
               "' data-total-house-services='",jesi$c2_housing_emp_raw_count,
               "' data-shelter-house-services='",jesi$housing_raw_count,
               "' data-career-house-services='",jesi$employment_raw_count,
               "' data-total-preven-services='",jesi$c3_preven_inter_raw_count,
               "' data-reentry-preven-services='",jesi$prevention_raw_count,
               "' data-youthdev-preven-services='",jesi$youth_dev_raw_count,
               "' data-total-fam-services='",jesi$c4_fam_comm_raw_count,
               "' data-human-fam-services='",jesi$human_srvs_raw_count,
               "' data-advocacy-fam-services='",jesi$advocacy_raw_count,
               "' data-zip-details='",jesi$zipcode,
               "' data-health-category-details='",jesi$c1_health_well_category,
               "' data-house-category-details='",jesi$c2_housing_emp_category,
               "' data-preven-category-details='",jesi$c3_preven_inter_category,
               "' data-fam-category-details='",jesi$c4_fam_comm_category,
               "'></div></div>")

# create custom legend labels
labels <- c(
"Lowest (0-19th Percentile)",
"Low (20-39th Percentile)",
"Moderate (40-59th Percentile)",
"High (60-79th Percentile)",
"Highest (80-100th Percentile)")

# build map
leaflet(jesi, width = "100%", height = "600px", options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE)) %>%

# add base map
# new code: add base map
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_nolabels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>'
    ) %>%
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_only_labels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      # attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
      options = providerTileOptions(pane = "markerPane") # retain unique setting 
    ) %>%
# add map panes
addMapPane("index_pane", zIndex = 400) %>%
addMapPane("missing_pane", zIndex = 410) %>% 
  addMapPane("jeni", zIndex = 415) %>%
addMapPane("sds_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%
addMapPane("spas_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%


# set view and layer control
  setView(-118.6368454, 34.2324274, zoom = 8.5) %>%
addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Supervisorial Districts","Service Planning Areas", "JENI - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, autoZIndex = TRUE)) %>%

  
# create sidebar and add html for content
addControl(html='<div class="leaflet-popup-scrolled" id="sidebar1"><div class="zipcode-header"   style="margin-bottom: 8px; margin-top: 8px;"><span class="square-icon"></span><span class="zip" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;"></span></div><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.5em;">Health & Wellness Percentile*:<span class="health-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> |
<span class="health-category color-format-health" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight:bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-health"></div></div><br/>JESI & Other Component Percentiles*</span><br/><span style="font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5em;">JESI:<span class="jesi-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-jesi"></div></div><br/>Housing & Employment:<span class="house-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-house"></div></div><br/>Prevention & Intervention:<span class="preven-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-preven"></div></div><br/>Community Services & Advocacy:<span class="fam-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fam"></div></div><br/><br/><span style="line-height: 1.5em; display: block; width: 95%;"><span class="zip-details" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> has a <span class="health-category-details color-format-health"></span> Health & Wellness service level. It also scores <span class="house-category color-format-house"></span> on Housing & Employment,
<span class="preven-category color-format-preven"></span>
on Prevention & Intervention, <span class="fam-category color-format-fam"></span> on Community Services & Advocacy, and  <span class="jesi-category color-format-jesi"></span> on JESI overall.<br/><br/>Neighborhood: <span class="neighborhood" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>JESI Rank: <span class="jesi-rank" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> out of 277 ZIP Codes<br/>Population: <span class="population" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>Supervisorial District: <span class="sd-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> | <span class="sd-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>Service Planning Area: <span class="spa-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> | <span class="spa-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/><br/><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;">Health & Wellness Organizations</span><br/>Total Health & Wellness Services: <span class="total-health-services" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>Physical Health & Wellbeing Services: <span class="physical-health-services" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br/>Behavioral Health Services: <span class="behavioral-health-services" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span></span><br/><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic;">*Percentiles range from 0-100. A higher percentile means a higher level of services in that area.</span></span></div>', position = "topleft") %>%
    

# add polygons for JESI ZIP Codes
addPolygons(color = "black", weight = 1, smoothFactor = 0.5, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            fillOpacity = .8, fillColor = ~pal_impact(c1_health_well_pctl), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 5, bringToFront = TRUE, sendToBack = TRUE), 
popup = ~popup,
group = "JESI", options = pathOptions(pane = "index_pane")) %>%

# add polygons for ZIP Codes wit no JESI
  addPolygons(data=nojesi,color="#444444", weight = 1, smoothFactor = 0.5, fillOpacity = .8, fillColor ="#808080", highlight = highlightOptions(color = "#444444", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE, sendToBack = TRUE), 
popup = ~paste0(
"ZIP Code:<b> ", nojesi$zipcode, "</b></br>",
"No JESI Available</br>Population:<b> ", nojesi$population_count, "</b></br>"),
options = pathOptions(pane = "missing_pane"))%>%  
  
# add boundaries for SPAs and SDs
addPolygons(data = sds, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            dashArray = "10 5",
            fillOpacity=0, color = "black", weight = 2.5, label=~distname, group = "Supervisorial Districts", options = pathOptions(pane = "sds_pane", interactive = FALSE), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = spas, 
              opacity = 1.0,
              dashArray = "5 5",
              fillOpacity=0, color = "black", weight = 2.5, label=~spa_2012, group = "Service Planning Areas", options = pathOptions(pane = "spas_pane", interactive = FALSE), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%  

# add boundaries for highest need JENI Zips
addPolygons(data = jeni_highest, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            fillOpacity=0, color = "black", weight = 2.5, label=~zipcode, group = "JENI - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes", options = pathOptions(pane = "jeni", interactive = FALSE), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE)) %>% 

  #add combined legend  
    addLegend(position = "bottomleft",
            title="Health & Wellness Service Level",
            labels = c("Lowest (0-19th Percentile)", "Low (20-39th Percentile)",
                       "Moderate (40-59th Percentile)", "High (60-79th Percentile)","Highest (80-100th Percentile)", "JESI Not Available"),
```
